i prodotti della Natura

We are interested in joining projects on soil health, circular biomass use, water resilience, biodiversity and carbon farming.

We manage a 22.6-hectare farm in southern Tuscany, bringing together Inula and Cistus cultivation, olive trees, woodland and natural regeneration.

We connect landscape management with the development of CÍGNULA and INBRUMA dei Carbonari, using local plant biomass for soil applications.

We bring an operating Mediterranean farm, practical experience in biomass processing, soil monitoring activities and continuity on the ground. Our digital skills include spatial visualisation, XR and interactive communication.

We want to develop product characterisation and field trials; soil and water monitoring; and assessment of carbon, biodiversity, costs and labour. A shared question runs through this work: how can landscape care support both healthier soils and a viable farm business?

We are looking for research teams and consortia seeking a farm partner to develop, test and document these approaches in Mediterranean conditions.
